ui.也可按 Ctrl+V；上传前会验证文件确实是图片: You can also press Ctrl+V; files are validated as images before upload
ui.FFmpeg：未找到（可放入 embedded-tools/ffmpeg/ffm: FFmpeg: not found (place it at embedded-tools/ffmpeg/ffmpeg.exe)
ui.答案不正确，功能未启用。: Incorrect answer; the feature was not enabled.
ui.此操作不可逆，确定删除选中的 {selected} 项（共 {count} 个文: This cannot be undone. Delete the selected {selected} items ({count} files total)?
ui.更新将在退出后替换程序文件，data 数据会保留。是否立即重启？: The update will replace program files after exit and preserve data. Restart now?
ui.ModelScope 上发现版本 {version}，是否使用 aria2-ne: Version {version} was found on ModelScope. Download and prepare it with aria2-next?
ui.把不同仓库中的文件和目录组合到独立挂载点；填写父目录即可自动生成中间层级。: Combine files and folders from different repositories under independent mount points. Enter a parent path and intermediate folders are created automatically.
ui.映射内位置填写父目录，例如 /test/1；挂载 Animation-List: Enter a parent path such as /test/1. Mounting Animation-List places it at /test/1/Animation-List. Double-click a mapped path to move or rename the node.
ui.展示全部挂载点及自动生成的目录层级。叶节点右侧显示实际源节点。: Shows every mount point and its automatically generated hierarchy. Leaf nodes show their actual source on the right.
ui.已经存在同名挂载点: A mount point with this name already exists
ui.确定删除挂载点“{name}”及其全部节点吗？源仓库内容不会被删除。: Delete mount point “{name}” and all of its nodes? Source repository content will not be deleted.
ui.确认允许挂载点“{name}”执行写入？公开池和无权限仓库仍会拒绝操作。: Allow mount point “{name}” to write? Public pools and repositories without permission will still reject writes.
ui.请先新建或选择一个挂载点。: Create or select a mount point first.
ui.映射内父目录（中间目录会自动生成）：: Parent path in the mount (intermediate folders are automatic):
ui.挂载节点名称不能包含目录分隔符: The mounted node name cannot contain a path separator
ui.映射路径包含 Windows WebDAV 不允许的字符: The mapped path contains characters not allowed by Windows WebDAV
ui.每个盘符可独立挂载 /dav 或已在“WebDAV 映射”页面建立的挂载点。挂载: Each drive can independently mount /dav or a mount point created on the WebDAV Mappings page. Mounting requests administrator permission.
ui.同一个盘符只能配置一次。: A drive letter can only be configured once.
ui.没有可用的盘符可供配置。: No drive letter is available for configuration.
ui.请先卸载该盘符，再删除配置。: Unmount this drive before deleting its configuration.
ui.请先把监听范围改为“仅本机（127.0.0.1）”。: Set the listening scope to Local only (127.0.0.1) first.
ui.将通过管理员权限校验 WebClient 系统组件、修复缺失的服务注册项，配置: Administrator permission will be used to validate the WebClient component, repair missing service registration, configure BasicAuthLevel and file/directory limits, then restart the service. HTTP Basic Auth is unsuitable for LAN use, so this feature mounts only 127.0.0.1. The built-in Windows client also remains unsuitable for individual files over 4 GiB. Continue?
ui.当前有任务在进行，是否停止任务、保留断点和队列记录后关闭？: Transfers are active. Stop them, preserve breakpoints and queue records, then close?
ui.文件较大时谨慎使用此功能。: Use this feature cautiously with large files.
ui.一行一个链接，仅支持 http:// 或 https://。文件会先下载到本地临: Enter one link per line. Only http:// and https:// are supported. Files are downloaded to a local temporary directory before being uploaded to the current directory.
ui.请先在资源管理页打开一个可写的 ModelScope 仓库。: Open a writable ModelScope repository in Resources first.
ui.从链接导入需要可访问当前仓库的 Token 登录账户。: Importing from links requires a Token account that can access the current repository.
ui.请等待当前上传、下载或仓库任务完成后再从链接导入。: Wait for the current upload, download, or repository task to finish before importing from links.
ui.请至少输入一个 http(s) 链接: Enter at least one http(s) link
ui.插件通过内置下载队列获取、校验后解压到软件目录。: Plugins use the built-in download queue and are extracted into the application directory after verification.
ui.FFmpeg：下载未完成，点击按钮继续: FFmpeg: download incomplete; click the button to continue
ui.FFmpeg 将加入下载队列，并在当前下载完成后自动开始。: FFmpeg will be added to the download queue and will start automatically after the current download finishes.
ui.FFmpeg 已安装，图床 AVIF 自动转换现在会优先使用此版本。: FFmpeg is installed. Image-bed AVIF conversion will now prefer this version.
